_comment: BEFORE YOUR FIRST BUILD — replace every REPLACE_ME value below
ENV FILE STRATEGY
Each build profile carries two env sources:
envFile  → the gitignored .env.{profile} file in the project root.
Used by: expo start --env <name>, eas build --local.
EAS Cloud workers do NOT see gitignored files, so this
path is ignored during cloud builds.
env      → inline key-value pairs; always present in the repo.
EAS Cloud builds use these values exclusively.
When both are present, env OVERRIDES envFile.
Rule of thumb:
Edit the .env.{profile} file for local work.
Keep the inline env block in sync when you update a URL.
Never put secrets in either place — use EXPO_PUBLIC_* only.
PLACEHOLDERS TO REPLACE
1. build.preview.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
.env.staging  → EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
→ your staging HTTPS URL, e.g. https://staging-api.fuehrer.in
2. build.production.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
.env.production → EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL
→ your production HTTPS URL, e.g. https://api.fuehrer.in
3. Also update PRIMARY_HASH / BACKUP_HASH and PINNED_DOMAIN in:
plugins/withCertificatePinning.js
src/core/api/api.ts  (SSL_PINNED_HASHES / PINNED_HOSTNAME)
4. submit.preview.ios.appleId / submit.production.ios.appleId
→ your Apple ID email (App Store Connect login)
5. submit.preview.ios.appleTeamId / submit.production.ios.appleTeamId
→ 10-character Apple Team ID
https://developer.apple.com/account → Membership → Team ID
6. submit.preview.ios.ascAppId / submit.production.ios.ascAppId
→ App Store Connect numeric App ID (NOT the bundle ID)
App Store Connect → Apps → your app → App Information → Apple ID
7. submit.preview.android.serviceAccountKeyPath
submit.production.android.serviceAccountKeyPath
→ path to the Google service account JSON from Play Console.
Keep this file out of git (add it to .gitignore if needed).
8. Run once before building:
npx eas-cli init
Links the project to your Expo account and writes
expo.extra.eas.projectId into app.json automatically.
NOTE: _comment is a no-op field ignored by EAS CLI.
Delete it once the placeholders are filled if you prefer clean JSON.
